demand_outlook.claim: India's gelatin market is projected to register a CAGR of 2 to 3% every year in the next few years.
demand_outlook.quote: India's gelatin market is projected to register a CAGR of 2 to 3% every year in the next few years.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for medicines is expected to increase owing to the rapid growth of the ageing population across the world.
demand_outlook.quote: Owing to the rapid growth of the ageing population across the world, the demand for medicines is expected to increase.

margins_costs.claim: Material consumed in fiscal 2023-24 reduced by 1% due to better yield.
margins_costs.quote: Material consumed in fiscal 2023-24 reduced by 1%, which is due to better yield, power and fuel cost reduce by 1.5% due to improvement in boiler's efficiency, which resulted in lower consumption of coal and also due to decrease in the coal prices.

margins_costs.claim: Power and fuel cost reduced by 1.5% due to improvement in boiler's efficiency, lower coal consumption, and a decrease in coal prices.
margins_costs.quote: power and fuel cost reduce by 1.5% due to improvement in boiler's efficiency, which resulted in lower consumption of coal and also due to decrease in the coal prices.

margins_costs.claim: Employee cost stood at 8.21% of revenue from operations compared to 7.17% in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: Employee cost stood at 8.21% (7.17% previous year) of revenue from operations.

margins_costs.claim: Other expenses were on the higher side at 6.35% compared to 6.23% of revenue from operations in the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: Other expenses were on the higher side at 6.35% as compared to the previous year at 6.23% of revenue from operations.

risks_headwinds.claim: The availability of the main raw material, crushed bones, is a cause of concern and difficulty in sourcing good quality raw material is a major issue.
risks_headwinds.quote: The availability of our main raw material, i.e. crushed bones, is a cause of concern The difficulty in sourcing good quality raw material is a major issue.

risks_headwinds.claim: The rise of plant-based gelatin substitutes, fueled by rising demand for vegetarian and vegan goods, is one of the primary market barriers.
risks_headwinds.quote: The rise of plant-based gelatin substitutes, fueled by rising demand for vegetarian and vegan goods, is one of the primary market barriers.

risks_headwinds.claim: There is increasing evidence that low-cost industrial or technical grade gelatin unfit for human consumption is being imported from China.
risks_headwinds.quote: According to the minutes of the meeting of the Drugs Consultative Committee – there is an increasing evidence that low cost industrial or technical grade gelatin unfit for human consumption is being imported from China, by unscrupulous traders and sold to capsule manufacturers who blend it with high quality gelatin made in India, in the manufacturing of capsules.
